what: On hover the border stays put and only the inner picture comes slightly closer at 1.02x over .6 seconds

options.--fx-scale: Scale (via style), default 1.02 — Brand collab · Instagram use 1.1
options.--fx-dur: Duration (via style), default .6s — Brand A product card 1.8s — Brand B piece image .18s — Brand C collab .5s · Instagram .3s
options.--fx-ease: Curve (via style), default --kf-ease-out — Brand A uses cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1) — Brand B uses ease — Brand C uses cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)
options.look: deep: [data-fx-part nested deep inside the photo frame=inner] scales on hover of the whole card (title included) — the frame stays as is (Brand work card)
options.--fx-dim: Inner image opacity on hover (via style), default 1 (no change) — haptic work card .9
